ops.title: Stop stance nudges scoring the human's own words
ops.description: Session 8a7b6ed4 fired the stewardship nudge 12x on the USER's own prose (login left no usable credential -> NlpSignal noun=issue + verb=leave = weight 2 = threshold met alone). Neither the isMeta filter nor the per-text scope default (both shipped in 8.15.0) touches this class: the candidate pool has no origin attribution. Options: tighten the issue+leave clause, or add assistant-origin scoping for stance hooks so hooks about Claude's own behavior score only assistant-origin candidates (assistant text, thinking, prose-tool inputs).

ops.text: the 8a7b6ed4 user-prose shape gets an inline regression test that expects Allow
a genuine assistant deflection still warns
